body.intent: Fix: Test scripts depend on the host: daemon scripts start nothing when TMPDIR sits on a small tmpfs (the minFree guard reads the host's free disk), and on Linux sh is dash so background daemons need sh -c '... exec rhiza daemon ...'. Scripts should set RHIZA_TEST_FREE_BYTES (or minFree 0) and use portable shell so make check passes the same on macOS and Ubuntu
